resources.string: Use these guides to prepare a request for support. The guides work offline. Official sources open in your browser.
Brazilian Law No. 10,048 includes autistic people in priority service. Ask reception about priority service and any documentation. In emergency services, medical protocols govern priority.
I am autistic. Where can I request priority service?
Ask to meet with the school to discuss accommodations. Brazilian Law No. 12,764 provides for a specialized support person when the need is demonstrated for autistic students in mainstream classes.
I would like to discuss the support I need to participate in school activities. Can we agree on next steps?
Article 24 of the Brazilian Inclusion Act guarantees access to health information through accessible communication. Tell the team how you prefer to receive questions, respond and take breaks.
I need time to respond. Please ask one question at a time and let me answer in writing or with my communication board.
